descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
The dream drive, from the driver's seat - in London.

THE CAR
A right-hand-drive V12 sports car with a race cockpit: racing wheel, bucket seats, roll cage, shift lights and a live display. Reach out with your own hands - grip the wheel, work the stick with your left hand, pull the handbrake - or drive with the joysticks.

A REAL 6-SPEED MANUAL
Move the stick through a real H-pattern: 1 3 5 up top, 2 4 6 underneath, reverse far right. Rev to the shift lights and snap the next gear in. Prefer to cruise? Switch to automatic.

29 MILES OF WEST LONDON, ON THE LEFT
The M4 past Heathrow, the M25, the A40 Western Avenue past the Hoover Building, the North Circular under the Wembley arch and the elevated M4 over Brentford. UK signs, mph and pounds.

ROAD EVENTS
Seven events on real roads: Heathrow Run, Orbital Blast, Western Avenue, North Circular, The Flyover, The Full Loop and Rush Hour. Race for gold - your best run comes back as a ghost car to beat.

SPEED CAMERAS AND NEAR MISSES
Six speed cameras record your top speed. In Rush Hour, close passes build your combo; a crash loses it.

SUNSET, DAY AND NIGHT - with an original soundtrack on London FM.

Plus British paint colours, twenty achievements, career ranks from L-Plates to King Of London, and a map with quick travel.
